edge: Line’s outside. Close along the outline. Get both ends of B’s anode in one frame.

north: Good. North along the west face to B. Hold depth.

abort: R-1, hand over. Circle what’s uninspected. Next watch dives from this page.
sign: Season log’s here. You sign as pilot. I’ll take the next box.
again: R-1, copy? Call the side you can see.
